name: feedback-server
description: Agent-first management for FeedbackServer products, public feedback, activity, roadmaps, releases, attachments, Bark, and audit records.

interface.shortDescription: Manage app feedback without an admin GUI.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to FeedbackServer through a local MCP process with scoped administrator API tokens and risk-based confirmations.
defaultPrompt: List my apps and summarize unresolved feedback.
Draft a reply to recent feedback and show me before sending.
Review roadmap items and draft the next changelog.
